notes.title: Do you want to play Dodgeball?
notes.content:
Our Game DodgeBall Is Coming Soon!
A competitive game where you can challenge your opponents one-on-one, fight to survive in 1v5 matches, and experience various modes introduced in future updates. Our game will soon take its place on the Steam Store.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082663/8cbbc545b253ec1fa6c4eae8f60b557a50b8839a.jpg

Are You Ready to Join the Excitement?


 With the upcoming Clan category, you’ll be able to participate in all tournaments.
 Fight for real cash prizes in tournaments organized by professional organizations.

Remember, "Competitiveness is the art of pushing your limits to make a difference."
